MINUTES
  TRAFFIC AND SAFETY COMMITTEE
  NOVEMBER 13, 2019

 1.  CHAIR SCHMITZ called the meeting to order at 6:00 pm.

 2.  ROLL CALL

  COMMITTEE MEMBERS PRESENT:  Schmitz, Boothe, Combs, Martin, Munday,
  Vanden Bos, Pope

  COMMITTEE MEMBERS ABSENT:  Retz, Lum

  STAFF PRESENT:  David Wahba, Director of Community Development & Public Works
  Joanne Itagaki, Traffic Engineering Deputy
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

 3.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

 A.  TRAFFIC AND SAFETY COMMITTEE DRAFT MINUTES, MEETING OF AUGUST 14,
  2019

 COMMITTEE MEMBER VANDEN BOS made a motion, seconded by COMMITTEE MEMBER
 MARTIN to,

  APPROVE THE TRAFFIC AND SAFETY COMMITTEE MEETING MINUTES OF
  AUGUST 14, 2019.

 There being no objection, CHAIR SCHMITZ so ordered.

 4.  AUDIENCE ITEMS WRITTEN/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON AGENDA

 NONE

 5.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

 A.  MOCCASIN LANE – FOLLOW-UP ON ADDITIONAL TRAFFIC CONTROLS

 Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki provided a summary of the staff report explaining the three
 options for traffic controls on Moccasin Lane, which include: 1) installing ADA ramps, relocating
 the crosswalk and signs; 2) add a bulb out to the residential side of Moccasin Lane; 3) install a
 flexible sign in the middle of the roadway; and, 4) a combination of the all options. Traffic
 Engineering Deputy Itagaki stated that Ms. Conterno, Moccasin Lane resident, discussed these
 options with her neighbors and received about five comments; the majority opted for Option 1.

 Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki suggested putting a 4” white dashed line at the end of the red
 curb prior to the curve with the idea to provide direction on where drivers stop. There would be a
 need for the school to provide parents/caregivers educational material on where to stop during
 pick-up and drop-off.

TRAFFIC & SAFETY COMMITTEE MEETING
  1
MINUTES
  Christine Constantini, resident, stated that the issues have been addressed very well and is
 concerned with the safety of the children. She stated that the school’s principal asked that in
 addition to the ADA ramps, can smaller moveable signs be provided by the city.

 Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki stated that the crosswalk and signs can be moved prior to the
 installation of the ADA ramps. The dashed white line can also be installed on a trial basis and
 the school borrow a barricades for temporary “wait here” signs. The City can work with the school
 to develop materials for educating parents/caregivers on this new circulation for the crosswalk.

 COMMITTEE MEMBER BOOTHE made a motion, seconded by COMMITTEE MEMBER SCOTT
 to,

  MOVE THE CROSSWALK NORTH, WAIT TO INSTALL THE ADA RAMPS UNTIL IT IS
  KNOWN THAT THIS IS THE RIGHT LOCATION, TRIAL RUN OF THE WAITING
  LINE FOR THE CARPOOL LANE, AND PROVIDE ADDITIONAL SIGNAGE.

Ayes: Schmitz, Boothe, Combs, Martin, Munday, Vanden Bos, Pope
Noes:
Absent: Lum, Retz
Abstain:

 Item 7 taken out of order

 7.  COMMITTEE ITEMS/FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

 CHAIR SCHMITZ stated that City Council rotations occur in January and this may be her last
 Traffic & Safety Committee. She thanked all Committee Members for volunteering their time to
 the City.

 COMMITTEE MEMBER SCOTT asked about an earlier discussion regarding bringing back the
 two left turn lanes for eastbound Palos Verdes Drive North to northbound Hawthorne Blvd.

 Director Wahba responded by stating that the left turn lane is much longer than it was before. He
 also stated to have the through lanes to continue on Palos Verdes Drive North only one left turn
 lane was installed. He stated that the left turn lane generally clears with the left turn signal cycle.

 COMMITTEE MEMBER SCOTT stated that the City of Torrance has done extensive work on
 three directions going into Crenshaw Blvd. and Pacific Coast Highway, however, the one that has
 not been addressed is southbound Crenshaw Blvd. to eastbound Pacific Coast Highway. He
 stated that this intersection is their next project and stated that there should be a dual left and
 dual right in that intersection. Director Wahba stated that this is also under Cal Trans control.

 6.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

 Director of Community Development and Public Works Wahba stated that at their last meeting,
 the City Council approved a contract with Willdan to do preliminary design work for improving the
 roadway on Rolling Hills Road regarding the addition of bike lanes. The proposed bike lane
 improvements on Palos Verdes Drive East will be considered next fiscal year.

TRAFFIC & SAFETY COMMITTEE MEETING
  2
MINUTES
  Rolling Hills Road will be the first project and once the preliminary design is ready, it will be
 presented to the Traffic and Safety Committee for review.

 COMMITTEE MEMBER SCOTT asked about a previous discussion regarding adding a bike lane
 to Palos Verdes Drive East. Director Wahba stated that this will also be part of the preliminary
 design.

 8.  ADJOURNMENT

 CHAIR SCHMITZ adjourned the meeting at 6:46 pm. The next Traffic and Safety Committee
 meeting will be held on Wednesday, February 12, 2020 at 6:00 pm.

TRAFFIC & SAFETY COMMITTEE MEETING

MINUTES
